description:
Approximate Dimensions of the property: 25 X 100
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by Plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
The property is being sold subject to any and all tenancies, possessory interests and/or leases, if any, affecting the premises not made party defendants. There are tenants in possession. The property is subject to certain easements and restrictions of record. The property is believed to be occupied.
The sale of this property is subject to the following:
1. Outstanding sewer charges for the second quarter of 2025 in the approximate amount of $140.00 as of May 1, 2025 plus interest;
2. Outstanding municipal taxes for the second quarter of 2025 in the approximate amount of $1,738.44 as of May 1, 2025 plus interest; and
3. Tax Sale Certificate #24-00024 with an outstanding balance of $17,382.98 plus interest*.
*Redemption figures can be obtained from the Tax Collector’s Office for the Borough of Highlands
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon. The purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagee or agent of the Mortgagee’s attorneys. If the sale is set aside for any reason the purchaser at the sale shall be entitled to only a return of the deposit paid. The purchaser shall have no further recourse against the mortgagor; the mortgagee or the mortgagee’s attorney.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description can be found at the Monmouth County Sheriff’s office is annexed to certain mortgages as follows:
1. Recorded on November 17, 2022 in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County as instrument #2022112445 and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Monmouth County.
The approximate anticipated upset price and amount to be satisfied by the sale of this property is $123,828.45 (consisting of $121,476.26 for the judgment and $2,352.19 for attorneys’ fees) to be increased by $25.44 per day from May 8, 2025 through the date of the Sheriff's Sale.
